pītanibhāsa.p: [ pīta + nibhāsa ] (ti) Google Translate Yellow color.

R:
pītanibhāsa：ပီတ-နိဘာသ （တိ）
ရွှေသော အရောင်ရှိသော။
DOP: 2 pīta mfn. [ ts ], yellow; Abh 97; 1008; D I 76, 23 (suttaṃ … nīlaṃ vā ~aṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā …); II 96, 6 (ekacce Licchavī ~ā honti °-vaṇṇā °-vatthā °âlaṅkārā); A V 61, 30 (kaṇṇikārapupphaṃ ~aṃ °-vaṇṇaṃ °-nidassanaṃ °-nibhāsaṃ); Vv 22:1; Ja IV 287, 5* (~āni himavato pabbatassa kūṭāni dassaneyyāni; 287, 21´ : ~ānī ti sovaṇṇamayāni); VI 185, 28 (nīlo ~o lohito odāto mañjeṭṭhako hohi); Vism 304, 11* (yaṃ so vaṇṇaṃ cintayati nīlaṃ ~aṃ ca lohitaṃ); Vv-a 201, 7 (pītapāsādasayane ti … sabbattha heṭṭhā upari ca °-saddena suvaṇṇam eva gahitan ti daṭṭhabbaṃ); Mhv 5:27; — pītaruṇāvuto in Ee at Thī 479 is wr; prob. read pi taruṇavuto with Th App II, p. 247, 6* ; — ° âvalepana , n. , yellow plaster; M I 385, 7 (~aṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rañjitaṃ; Ps III 94, 20 : bahalabahalaṃ ~-raṅgajātaṃ gahetvā rajitvā); — °- nibhāsa , mfn. , of yellow appearance or lustre; D II 111, 2 ; M II 14, 2 ; Dhs 247; — apīta , mfn. , not yellow; Vism 366, 34 = As 299, 15 .

pītanidassana.p: [ pīta + nidassana ] (ti) Google Translate He is a scholar and must see. It should be seen as yellow. Pitawana-see.

R:
pītanidassana：ပီတ-နိဒဿန （တိ）
အရွှေဟူ၍ ရှုအပ်သော။ ရွှေသည်ဖြစ်၍ ထင်သော။

pītanisita.p: [ pīta + nisita ] (ti) Google Translate The one who poured out the water and put the blood on the stone to drink the water.

pītānisaṃsa.p: [ pīti + ānisaṃsa ] (ti) Google Translate Affectionate. Pitata-see.

R:
pītānisaṃsa：ပီတာနိသံသ （တိ） （ပီတိ+အာနိသံသ）
နှစ်သက်ခြင်းဟူသော အာနိသင် ရှိသည်။
